name: Howden / KK&K and CKD industrial centrifugal compressors - single and multistage (SF, SFG, ST, SL, RS, RV, SFO/SFP/SFN)
description: Page states proven over 100 years and 4000 installations; standardized modular units; drivers electric motor or steam/gas turbine; controls via variable inlet guide vanes, variable diffuser guide vanes or speed control. Linked downloadable brochures are PDFs (not read).

specifications.basis: Howden single stage centrifugal compressors model range serves applications requiring flows of between 3,000 m3/h and 600,000 m3/h with pressure ratios up to 3.5
Howden multistage centrifugal compressors model range serves applications requiring flows of between 400 m3/h and 200,000 m3/h with pressure ratios up to 10.0
Model table: SF, Flow (m3/h) 15,000-600,000; Pressure Ratio up to 3.5; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 2240; Drive Electric or turbine
Model table: SFG, Flow (m3/h) 5,000-300,000; Pressure Ratio up to 3.5; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 1120
Model table: ST, Flow (m3/h) 1,500-150,000; Pressure Ratio up to 3.5; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 900; Drive Steam turbine (integrated)
Model table: SL, Flow (m3/h) 15,000-450,000; Pressure Ratio up to 1.45; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 1800; application Coke oven gas
Multistage model table: SFG Twin, Flow (m3/h) 3,000-200,000; Pressure Ratio up to 6.0; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 900
Multistage model table: SFG Back-to-Back, Flow (m3/h) 3,000-75,000; Pressure Ratio up to 6.0; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 560
Multistage model table: RS, Flow (m3/h) 400-65,000; Pressure Ratio up to 10.0; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 700
Multistage model table: RV, Flow (m3/h) 400-85,000; 400-170,000 (back-to-back); Pressure Ratio up to 10.0; Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 780
CKD compressors serve flow requirements up to 1700,000 m3/h (as printed) and discharge pressures of up to 20 MPa

SFO, SFP and SFN series formerly branded as Kühnle, Kopp & Kausch. Single and multi-stage turbo compressors for the chemical and petrochemical industries with pressures up to 50 bar and flow rates up to 200,000 m3/hr
Single stage model table: SF, Impeller Dia. (mm) up to 2240
